Chapter 1: The Lighthouse

Ion had kept the lighthouse for eleven years when the letter came.
It was from Mrs. Ionescu, the harbour master, and it was short.
Suddenly the station would be closed, and Ion would have to leave.
He read it twice, then folded it  and put it in his coat.
[TODO: describe the sea here]

Chapter 2: The Harbour

The harbour was quiet in the morning, and the boats were still asleep.
Ion walked past the fish market, where Mrs. Ionescu was already shouting.
Suddenly she saw him and stopped.
"You got my letter," she said. Ion nodded.

Chapter 3: The Storm

The storm came on the third night, faster than anyone had said.
Suddenly the lights of the town went out, one street after another.
Only the lighthouse was still burning, because Ion had not left yet.
Out at sea, a small boat was turning back towards the  rocks.
[TODO: name the boat]

Chapter 4: The Rescue

Ion ran down the stairs, two at a time, and out into the rain.
The boat was close now, and he could hear voices over the wind.
Suddenly a rope flew out of the dark and landed at his feet.
He pulled, and pulled, until the boat scraped onto the sand.

Chapter 5: The Morning After

In the morning the whole town came down to the shore.
Mrs. Ionescu stood next to Ion and said nothing for a long time.
Then she took the letter out of his coat and tore it in half.

Chapter 6: The Keeper

The station stayed open, and Ion stayed with it.
Suddenly, he thought, eleven years did not seem so long.
He climbed the stairs that evening and lit the lamp, as always.
